LANGUAGE-SPECIFIC GUIDANCE:
Language: PYTHON
  Key sinks: cursor.execute, os.system, subprocess.run, eval, exec, pickle.loads
  Safe patterns (skip these): parameterized queries with %s placeholders, subprocess.run with list args (no shell=True)
  DO NOT FLAG: Django ORM queries (uses parameterized queries internally), SQLAlchemy text() with bound params
  Framework notes: Check for Django/Flask/FastAPI-specific patterns. Django auto-escapes templates. Flask Jinja2 auto-escapes.
